why: ManpowerGroup's own PR Newswire notice of 2026-10-01 gives Q3 results before the open on 2026-10-15, with a webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET.
session_evidence: Before market open, webcast 8:30 a.m. ET on 2026-10-15, per the company notice (https://finviz.com/news/397869/manpowergroup-to-announce-3rd-quarter-2026-earnings-results)
where_to_look: Country-level staffing data released since July that map onto MAN's mix: France (Prism'emploi/DARES interim), Italy, and US BLS temporary help services. France is the largest segment, so French temp-work series are the most direct read on the quarter.
Q3 releases from peers that have already reported (e.g. Adecco/Randstad pre-announcements or trading updates, US staffing peers) for the European trend.
The Q4 guide is what moved the last print. Look for currency (EUR/USD over Q3) and tax-rate assumptions against the Q3 guide of $0.96 to $1.06 at a 44% tax rate.
Short positioning: the July squeeze (+32%) came off a heavily shorted base. Check the latest FINRA settlements for whether shorts rebuilt.
already_in_the_wire: Q3 EPS guide $0.96 to $1.06 (2c FX headwind, 44% tax) from the Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000871763/000119312526305399/man-ex99_1.htm)
Q2 revenue +5.8% cc to $4.86bn against a 1 to 5% forecast; Jefferson Wells US sale
